description: Only case IDs with source-linked editorial claim cards appear here. No source independence or corroboration is declared. All claims require editorial sign-off before publication.

cases.scope: Only the institution's collection description has been inspected. These are statements about its records, not independent measurements of the reported event.

documents.title: UK National Archives — UFO reports: Rendlesham correspondence
documents.author: The National Archives (UK)

claims.text: The National Archives describes a single-sheet report as the only record of the Rendlesham event itself in its holdings; other files largely concern subsequent enquiries.

citations.locator: Correspondence on the Rendlesham Forest incident — paragraph on the single-sheet report
citations.context: Scope limited to records held by this archive, not all documents ever created.

claims.text: The Archives describes the Ministry of Defence as having found no defence interest or threat to UK airspace in the reported incident.

citations.locator: Correspondence on the Rendlesham Forest incident — paragraph about Parliamentary Question and defence interest
citations.context: An assessment of defence significance is not a physical identification of the lights.

cases.scope: These claims document the remit and findings described by official archives; they do not establish the origin of every Roswell allegation or the independence of later witnesses.

documents.title: US National Archives — Project Blue Book: The Roswell Incident
documents.author: US National Archives and Records Administration

claims.text: The US National Archives says it could not locate Roswell documentation among its Project Blue Book records.

citations.context: This is a statement about the Blue Book holdings searched; it is not a claim that no other relevant records exist.

claims.text: The GAO's 28 July 1995 report examined relevant government records and requirements for reporting air accidents concerning the 1947 Roswell event.

citations.locator: Report Highlights — two stated areas of focus
citations.context: The remit is an archival investigation, not a scientific test of all later eyewitness narratives.

evidence.locator: The Roswell Incident — paragraphs beginning 'At the request of Congressman Steven H. Schiff' and describing the 1994 GAO audit
evidence.context: NARA specifically discusses the GAO's investigation and later report. This is a checked reference to that government audit, NOT evidence that NARA's full summary was copied from or corroborated by the GAO report.
